content:
Your input fields are:
1. `use_cases` (str): User's selected use cases, preferences, and Q&A answers as a summary
2. `budget_total` (int): Total build budget in USD; -1 means the user has set no budget at all
3. `cpu_budget_ceiling` (int): Maximum to spend on CPU in USD; -1 means no ceiling. The user has said cost is not a constraint
4. `candidates` (str): JSON list of compatible CPUs with street prices. Fields: name, brand, cores, threads, base_clock_ghz, boost_clock_ghz, tdp_w, socket, ddr_gen, has_integrated_graphics, pcie_lanes, memory_channels, supports_ecc, street_price_usd. The last three are null on consumer desktop parts. That absence is meaningful, not missing data. When a game performance envelope is available, performance_headroom and meets_performance_profile report whether the measured CPU clears it; prefer a verified fit.
Your output fields are:
1. `reasoning` (str): 
2. `cpu_name` (str): Exact product name of the chosen CPU, matching a name from candidates
3. `reason` (str): 1-2 sentences. Lead with the value argument, not the spec argument.
4. `reconsideration_threshold` (str): One sentence stating the price point at which a different candidate becomes worth considering. Be specific with a dollar figure.
All interactions will be structured in the following way, with the appropriate values filled in.

[[ ## use_cases ## ]]
{use_cases}

[[ ## budget_total ## ]]
{budget_total}

[[ ## cpu_budget_ceiling ## ]]
{cpu_budget_ceiling}

[[ ## candidates ## ]]
{candidates}

[[ ## reasoning ## ]]
{reasoning}

[[ ## cpu_name ## ]]
{cpu_name}

[[ ## reason ## ]]
{reason}

[[ ## reconsideration_threshold ## ]]
{reconsideration_threshold}

[[ ## completed ## ]]
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        OPTIMIZED decidecpu 0: be precise.

[[ ## use_cases ## ]]
in-use_cases

[[ ## budget_total ## ]]
in-budget_total

[[ ## cpu_budget_ceiling ## ]]

[[ ## candidates ## ]]
in-candidates

[[ ## reasoning ## ]]
out-reasoning

[[ ## cpu_name ## ]]
out-cpu_name

[[ ## reason ## ]]
out-reason

[[ ## reconsideration_threshold ## ]]
out-reconsideration_threshold

[[ ## completed ## ]]

[[ ## use_cases ## ]]
q-use_cases

[[ ## budget_total ## ]]
q-budget_total

[[ ## cpu_budget_ceiling ## ]]
q-cpu_budget_ceiling

[[ ## candidates ## ]]
q-candidates

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## reasoning ## ]]`, then `[[ ## cpu_name ## ]]`, then `[[ ## reason ## ]]`, then `[[ ## reconsideration_threshold ## ]]`, and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.
